cases.procedure: Build from a clean checkout, verify source-bound frontend and Python artifacts, dependency hashes and reproducible inputs.
cases.expected: Exact commit and artifact checksums match; no private settings, credentials, flags or solutions enter public Git/artifacts.

cases.procedure: Build/export, upload/download through the intended cloud folder, verify SHA256, cold-import into a fresh isolated hypervisor and boot.
cases.expected: Firmware/controller/NIC/disk settings work without the build VM or local caches; initial credentials rotate and networking is isolated.

cases.procedure: Install on a blank supported nested Proxmox host, reboot, rerun preflight, inspect every VM, disk, unit, route and database role.
cases.expected: Complete, idempotent documented installation; interrupted installation has a verified checkpoint recovery path; secrets remain private.

cases.procedure: Interrupt image downloads, package installation, VM import, network setup and monitoring setup at each recorded phase.
cases.expected: Bounded errors; usable console; no false completion; restart/recovery procedure restores a known state.

cases.procedure: For every public route and mutation test anonymous, student, creator, another creator, admin, revoked admin and forced-reset accounts.
cases.expected: Server enforces each permission independently of UI; no unauthorized file, account, grade, machine, token or metadata access.

cases.procedure: Test login/logout, session rotation, expiry, concurrent tabs, password reset, account deletion and replay of an old cookie.
cases.expected: Old sessions are revoked as designed; CSRF/origin checks reject cross-site requests; no account enumeration or secret leakage.

cases.procedure: Exercise failed login/signup/reset attempts from one and multiple source IPs, including valid recovery after the window.
cases.expected: Configured limits are enforced without unlimited memory growth or permanent account lockout; credentials never appear in responses/logs.

cases.procedure: Change each profile field and avatar; download VPN config; inspect public/private profile as another account; reset password and delete a disposable account.
cases.expected: Validation, privacy, durable refresh, attachment filenames and account cleanup match the documented contract.

cases.procedure: Open every route with realistic empty/large/malformed datasets; use filters, pagination and deep links; disconnect each API and retry.
cases.expected: Correct data and loading/error/empty states; no fake zero metrics; no stale mutation retries; no console errors or unbounded polling.

cases.procedure: Complete student and admin tasks using keyboard and screen reader; test focus after navigation, dialogs, validation, 200% zoom, contrast and reduced motion.
cases.expected: Labels, focus order, announcements and cancellation work; no keyboard trap or essential color-only state.

cases.procedure: Run Chromium, Firefox and WebKit on desktop and mobile sizes; test downloads, uploads, dialogs, history and expired sessions.
cases.expected: Supported browser matrix passes; unsupported cases are explicitly documented, not silently skipped.

cases.procedure: Remove all PHP routes/runtime/packages, replace their browser contracts with Flask, inspect installer/updater/Apache/worker/CLI references and cold boot.
cases.expected: No request or scheduled job depends on PHP, Composer or the retired webserver tree; rollback to the previous supported release still works.

cases.procedure: Upload valid small Linux/Windows OVA files; duplicate names; invalid extension/content; empty/oversized data; quota and unavailable storage.
cases.expected: Strict server-side validation, ownership, capacity and safe names; no partial registration or arbitrary file access.

cases.procedure: Upload a large artifact; retry duplicate/out-of-order chunks; tamper total size/index/upload owner; cancel and interrupt before/after finalize.
cases.expected: All chunks are accounted for exactly once; cross-user access fails; temporary files expire; ambiguous finalization is reconciled safely.

cases.procedure: Feed tar traversal, absolute names, links, duplicate members, XML entities, huge expansion, missing disks, malformed OVF and excessive virtual sizes.
cases.expected: No external fetch, path escape or resource exhaustion; actual and declared disk constraints agree; validation failures remove owned temporary files.

cases.procedure: Create and edit all machine/network/flag/hint combinations, image types, inactive/active/deleted states and invalid limits; reload saved definitions.
cases.expected: Every field round-trips, invalid topology is rejected before provisioning, only permitted creators/admins can change it, and failed imports are cleaned.

cases.procedure: Create/upload/start a new Linux exercise as a student, connect via VPN, solve all flags, extend time, stop and restart.
cases.expected: Entry points, flags, grades, limits, monitoring and teardown are correct at every transition.

cases.procedure: Repeat lifecycle using READY pool instances, concurrent assignment, pool depletion and replenishment.
cases.expected: Each instance has one owner; warm and cold starts preserve per-user flags; no stranded reservations or overprovisioning.

cases.procedure: Two students race for a lab and access each other's API IDs, VPN networks, files, flags and management actions.
cases.expected: Cross-instance/cross-tenant denial holds at UI, API, database and network boundaries; only the rightful owner receives grades.

cases.procedure: Expire and extend an exercise around clock boundaries; reboot workers; submit during teardown; disconnect a worker during provisioning.
cases.expected: A monotonic lifecycle prevents duplicate grading, orphaned VMs and missed expiry; reconciliation is bounded and observable.

cases.procedure: Exercise Windows standalone, domain controller/member, DHCP/DNS, reboot and agent enrollment, including delayed cloud initialization.
cases.expected: AD membership, machine identities, flags, routing and logs are correct after reboot; no shared student state.

cases.procedure: Probe all VM roles, student segments, management endpoints, IPv4/IPv6 and Internet egress; repeat after reboot and maintenance changes.
cases.expected: Only documented flows succeed; management APIs and other students remain inaccessible; monitoring captures intended traffic.

cases.procedure: Retire/restore/delete inactive and active owned exercises; repeat requests; interrupt teardown; try deleting foreign exercises.
cases.expected: Documented retention holds; affected instances are reconciled; no unrelated data loss or falsely successful partial deletion.

cases.procedure: Generate known host/network/security events in each role, trace them through agents, capture, Vector, ClickHouse, Wazuh and Grafana.
cases.expected: Expected events arrive with correct host/student/lab attribution and timestamps; gaps or failed pipelines are visible.

cases.procedure: Install timer on the separate archive VM; trigger it, reboot across a missed interval, overlap manual/timer runs and inspect unit sandbox/journal.
cases.expected: Persistent schedule catches up; one active writer per source; verified private copies and accurate receipts; no application-host privilege required.

cases.procedure: Inject unknown/changed SSH host key, broken key, unavailable source, changed log, same-size changed content, full archive disk and lost mount.
cases.expected: No unverified source removal; no silent fallback to the root filesystem; failures/stale receipts are visible and later recovery is safe.

cases.procedure: Restore a sampled archived event to an independent review directory and compare source digest; rotate readers' SSH keys.
cases.expected: A readable, complete, digest-matching archive can be recovered; old keys fail; source and destination retention are deliberate.

cases.procedure: View service/database/capacity/lifecycle/release/archive diagnostics with missing, failed, stale and malicious receipts; export a support JSON.
cases.expected: Server-side admin authorization holds; reports are bounded and contain no secrets/private paths; unknown values stay unknown.

cases.procedure: Revoke administrator privileges while a tab is open, then retry every administrator read and mutation.
cases.expected: Privileges are rechecked server-side; old UI/session state cannot retain administrator access.

cases.procedure: Try wrong source/release/config/dependency hashes, dirty source, unsupported versions, busy students, insufficient backup space and external disks.
cases.expected: Update stops before mutation or restores service safely; unsupported dependencies never bypass the release protocol.

cases.procedure: Roll the exact final commit and matching artifacts from the declared production baseline in an isolated restored clone.
cases.expected: All VM/SQL backups verify, migration ledger and source/assets/services agree, protected account/grade hashes match, release commits durably.

cases.procedure: Inject failure at every state-machine transition, migration, artifact install, service start, health check and data verification.
cases.expected: Before commit: verified baseline restore. After commit: finish/resume without replaying destructive work or reverting newer data.

cases.procedure: Write owned fixture data after upgrade, take a new safety checkpoint, deliberately roll back, interrupt restoration, then recover newer SQL/VM state.
cases.expected: Explicit version confirmation; old and newer checkpoints remain distinct and usable; task IDs cannot be replayed against the wrong checkpoint.

cases.procedure: Reboot each VM/host during maintenance and after commit; test expired/ambiguous Proxmox task requests.
cases.expected: Maintenance gate persists; writers and public traffic stay blocked until verified recovery; unknown tasks require explicit reconciliation.

cases.procedure: Independently restore each verified VM archive, source bundle, private settings and SQL backup onto fresh storage.
cases.expected: Recovered source, secrets, accounts, grades, images and network identities match; encrypted/offline backup access is tested.

cases.procedure: Run the planned class size and an agreed overload burst for a full lecture; measure p50/p95/p99, CPU/RAM/disk/IOPS and growth.
cases.expected: Documented capacity/SLO thresholds hold; admission control and failure messages remain bounded; no VM/session/log leaks.

cases.procedure: Exhaust inodes/bytes, remove archive/backup mounts, corrupt a disk image copy, delay storage IO and expire TLS certificates.
cases.expected: Fail closed for destructive operations; alert/failure details identify the component; restore from independent verified backups.

cases.procedure: Download the intended tutor/student artifacts from the actual restricted cloud folder on another workstation and verify checksums.
cases.expected: Correct access boundaries and version labels; no tutor solutions or credentials in student artifacts; all referenced assets are present.

cases.procedure: Follow every exercise sheet and tutor walkthrough from a clean imported VM; verify clues, flags, timings, reset and all style resources.
cases.expected: Documents build, steps solve the intended lab, expected flags/grades match, and reset returns students to the documented starting state.

cases.procedure: Run tests/browser/ui_smoke.py against its documented isolated target.
cases.expected: Every supported route/action passes with no runtime errors or unauthorized effects.

cases.procedure: Run tests/browser/live_smoke.py against its documented isolated target.

cases.expected: Both clients authenticate; revoking one publishes a signed CRL, disconnects only that client, denies reconnect, permits an idempotent retry and leaves the second connected. Test processes and temporary CA are removed.

cases.procedure: On the isolated disposable test host run tools/verification.py run --suite proxmox --strict with HEIST_ISOLATED_PROXMOX_TESTS=1, an unused HEIST_TEST_VMID below100000000 and HEIST_TEST_BACKEND_ENV pointing to private PVE credentials.
